title: Target one thousandth over the half-base line of a roof
description: More than half of the target's base is on the platform, so it has high ground; its own platform does not block the attacker.
basis: p. 38 'in terrain' means more than half the base (confirmed); U17, U19
ruling: At x = 10.000 the same target would be on the ground (exactly half); one thousandth inside it has high ground. The unit tests cover both sides.
